description: How often our settle value matched the venue's result, with every miss. No prices. A successful result also carries structuredContent: the format=json body (outputSchema).

fields.description: full (default) | compact: leave out null members of the JSON (structuredContent and format=json)

name: receipts

asof.description: Response time (UTC); when the QA ran is qa_at.

build.description: The running commit, 7 hex (dev off Tokay). With method, ties this body's numbers to the code and rules that made them (CONTRACTS §51).

credits.description: Credit strings to keep when you repeat numbers.

family.description: Family asked for, or null for all.

method.description: Method id: the contract rules that made this body's numbers (blend-median-v1, rain-month-v5, markets-nbm-led-v4, receipts-qa-v1, history-as-issued-v3, status-readiness-v1). A rule change gives a new id, so equal ids mean the same method (CONTRACTS §51).

qa_at.description: When the market QA last ran (UTC); null = never: nothing evaluated yet.

rows.description: One row per product x rule version.

days.description: Distinct checked event dates in the window (the body's `days` is the window).

differs.description: Misses; null until the claim minimum.

last_date.description: The newest checked event date; null when none (CONTRACTS §47).

match.description: Matches; null until the product has the claim minimum of checked events.

not_checkable.description: Events we could not check (reason in the misses).

rule_from.description: The rule version: first date it applies.

shown.description: True once match/differs may be shown (claim gate).

venue_asof.description: {venue: when groundhog last read its results (UTC)} for the venues behind this row; Kalshi: the last imported Kalshi file (none since 10/29, CONTRACTS §33).

state.description: unvalidated = 0 checked (not a perfect score); below_claim = checked but no product has the claim minimum (match/differs null); reported = at least one product shows match/differs.

venue.description: Venue asked for, or null for both.

title: Market receipts
